articles.summary: Three Emerge CDL graduates are already on the road with Imran Inc., our newest official employer partner. The Kansas-based interstate carrier hosts its own training to confirm recent graduates are road-ready, a model more fleets should be looking at.
articles.title: Emerge Career Partners With Imran Inc. to Put CDL Graduates on the Road

articles.summary: When a justice-involved veteran needs a fresh start, the system often fails them. Follow Michael's story of earning his CDL and finding an employer who truly values his service—showcasing the power of the Emerge Model.
articles.title: One Mission, Not Two: What Michael's Road Back Reveals About Veteran Reentry
